description: The seasonal sailing system encompasses ships, ship equipment, treasures, cabins, port supplies, and a naval PvP mode. Ships have levels with stat growth, equipment slots with random attributes, and gacha draws for obtaining new ships and treasures.

ConfigSeason_ship.description: Ship definitions. Each ship has a quality tier, appearance options, and unlock conditions.

item_id.description: Inventory item ID for this ship

default_unlock.description: Whether ship is unlocked by default (0/1)

ConfigSeason_ship_level.description: Ship level progression. Controls EXP costs, stat bonuses per level, and upgrade material requirements.

expend_exp.description: EXP required to reach this level

attr.description: Stat bonuses at this level [[attrId, value], ...]

ConfigSeason_ship_draw.description: Ship gacha/draw pool entries with weights and jackpot flags.

weight.description: Probability weight in the draw pool

is_jackpot.description: Whether this is a jackpot/featured reward (0/1)

limited.description: Maximum times this can be drawn (0=unlimited)

ConfigSeason_equipment.description: Ship equipment definitions. Equipment goes into specific ship parts (hull, sail, cannon, etc.) and can be upgraded.

multiple.description: Set bonus multipliers when multiple pieces equipped

gradeRange.description: Attribute grade range [min, max] for random rolls

ConfigSeason_equipment_attr.description: Random attribute pools for ship equipment. Each entry defines a possible stat roll with probability and value range.

pro.description: Probability weight for this attribute in random rolls

value.description: Value range [min, max] for the roll

ConfigSeason_pvp_chapter.description: Naval PvP battle chapters. Defines enemy power, ship cannon configurations, time limits, and rewards.

ConfigSeason_treasure.description: Ship treasure items that provide passive bonuses and can be leveled up.

ConfigSeason_cabin.description: Ship cabin configurations for assigning crew members and unlocking bonuses.

ship_progression.description: Ships level up by consuming EXP and materials. Each level grants stat bonuses defined in Season_ship_level.attr. Ships also have appearance skins that can be unlocked.
ship_progression.durability: Ships have a durability range [2500, 10000] as defined in SEASON_SHIP_DURABILITY_RANGE constant.
ship_progression.attributes: Ship stats displayed: ATK (10002), HP (10001), SPD (10003), DEF (10004) as per SEASON_SHIP_ATTR_SHOW constant.

equipment_system.description: Ship equipment fits into typed part slots. Equipment has random attribute rolls from Season_equipment_attr pools, with grade ranges controlling roll quality.
equipment_system.upgrade: Equipment has level tiers and advanced upgrade tiers. The 'multiple' field provides set bonus multipliers when equipping multiple pieces from the same set.
equipment_system.s4_variants: Season 4 introduced separate level and attribute tables (ConfigSeason_equipment_level_s4, ConfigSeason_equipment_attr_s4).

naval_pvp.description: PvP battles use ship cannon configurations. Left and right cannon arrays determine firepower. Battle calculates: ATK = round(att), speed factor = round(10000 * speed), and cannon damage multiplier = round(att_dam * (1 + att_resist)).
naval_pvp.combat_formula: Ship combat uses attacker ATT, ATT_DAM, and cannon-specific season_cannon_att_def resistance.

gacha.description: Ship draw system with weighted pools (Season_ship_draw). Jackpot items have is_jackpot=1. Limited items can only be drawn a set number of times. Fragments can be collected to assemble full ships.
